open_questions.title: Staleness detector: set-overlap feature (prev-para vs bare top-3 identity overlap)
open_questions.description: P130-b exhausted the cosine feature family (CV 84.1 vs always-anchor 84.3, oracle router 92.7). Registered next features: (ii) set feature — is the bare top-3 one of the same paragraphs as the anchor's region, a SET-membership signal rather than a mean cosine. Computable purely from p126b_rows.json? No — needs the per-row bare top-3 ids, not stored. Requires a re-run pass over the cached embeddings (local, no API).

open_questions.title: Census extension d in [300, 1000] (2-elementary + six-row negative control)
open_questions.description: P121 covered [1,300]. The completeness argument (2-elementary closure) is verified only to d=500 by form enumeration (P104/P117-b). Extending the Lambert-series census to [300,1000] AND the 2-elementary enumeration to [300,1000] widens the exhaustive-verification band at zero conceptual risk.
open_questions.cost_estimate: low (pure local mpmath, ~20 min for 700 values at reduced dps)

open_questions.title: Height-matched deg-matched mediation test (does the judge read gdepth or height?)
open_questions.description: P129/II.3 registered falsification design: equalize denominator size / CF period length within deg-matched pairs, keep gdepth different. Needs pair construction from the census + ~40 API calls.

open_questions.title: Uniform rule for the support coordinate s_d (the class-invariant table layer)
open_questions.description: s_d in {6,10,21,13,34} follows no known pattern in d; this is the Ramanujan/Weber table layer. Any 'rule' candidate must reproduce all five + predict d=1 (s=1 trivially) and fail on 35/55/77 (multi-support).
open_questions.cost_estimate: high (open math; no candidate rule known)

open_questions.title: Third-corpus DR replication (non-Wikipedia)
open_questions.description: DR1-DR10 magnitudes are SQuAD+L12-v2 specific (P127). Replicate the prefix/order/source findings on a different corpus.
